_comment: Featured projects, in README order. 'repo' is optional: when it exists on the account, language/stars/forks come live from the API; otherwise the card is drawn from this file alone. 'size' is 'wide' or 'half'. Edit and push, and the Cards workflow redraws them.

projects.title: WhatsApp AI Ordering Bot
projects.description: An AI-powered WhatsApp ordering system built for a pizza restaurant. It handles customer conversations, automates order processing, and supports menu and order-status management through an admin dashboard.

projects.title: Cafe POS
projects.description: A point-of-sale system for cafe operations, covering order management, backend APIs, database integration, and a web-based interface.

projects.title: Receipt Reconciler
projects.description: A receipt reconciliation application focused on processing and organizing receipt information.
